a: Up to $500K over a 24-month base period, plus an optional 12-month Director's Fellowship of up to $500K and an optional US-citizen graduate student add-on of up to $225K (at most $1.225M per award)
dt: YFA 2027 research announcement DARPARA2701 posted Oct 20, 2026: executive summaries due Nov 5, 2026, 4:00 pm ET; questions close Jan 5, 2027; full proposals due Jan 13, 2027, 4:00 pm ET
e: Current tenure-track faculty, tenured faculty within 3 years of their tenure date, or the equivalent at a non-profit research institution within 12 years of the doctorate; all personnel must be employed at a US institution. Foreign nationals may apply, but citizens of China, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia and Venezuela cannot be key or senior personnel; PIs with more than $500K in prior DARPA funding (or $1.25M from all DoW sources) are excluded.
